integrity: The written proof is analytic for all admissible finite fields; finite exact-arithmetic and Fourier checks are supporting tests. Historical priority remains subject to independent review.
scientific_limitations: Cubic moment curve only, characteristic greater than three; quantitative remainder controls squared-amplitude profiles, not coefficient phases. Prior sharp endpoint constant A_q is credited; an unindexed earlier exact stability identity cannot be excluded.
title: Sharp global sixth-moment stability with sparse saturation on finite-field moment curves
